name: Ághmach
text: Ághmach is the modern Irish spelling of Ágach, the Fomorian enemy of the Tuatha Dé Danann. MacKillop records the modern rendering as the contemporary form of the older name. The principal record sits under Ágach.

attributes.attribute: Modern Irish spelling of Ágach; pointer to Ágach headword

okr.objective: Ághmach is a MacKillop signpost to Ágach.
